emails.subject: Festive Sale: funding with Barkley & Co
emails.body:
Hi Anil,

Thank you for the offer. On our forecast the range reaching its sales target in the event is only 3.6% likely, so it counts as ₹0 against the ₹45,176 we asked for on those SKUs. Could you give the target a longer window, or turn the bonus into a guaranteed share?

Could you confirm by Friday?

Thanks
